name: Anwen
greeting: This copy names the offices, the orders and those who gave them. This other book belongs to the families.
lines: Anwen: The people whose lives it holds. They may let someone else read. They may refuse.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A woman returns a sealed page. She asks Anwen to keep her son's name and destroy the account of his last fear. Anwen asks once whether she is certain, then follows her instruction.

lines: Kael: Edric's order stays on the wall.
Anwen: Yes. His privacy was never the thing we were protecting.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: For the first time, the bell can mourn someone without claiming everything that happened to them.

lines: Anwen: The living still need timber and flour. Tor is at the bench. There is a world outside these books.
